projects.title: Project calculator
projects.intro: Explore the impact of a business decision before you commit. Adjust the assumptions to see what your cash position could look like.
projects.assumptionNote: These figures are assumptions for this simulation. Connect your accounting data to replace them with live balances.
projects.feasibleMessage: Your projected cash stays above your safety threshold after you {decision}.
projects.borderlineMessage: This decision brings you close to your safety threshold. Review the assumptions before proceeding.
projects.notFeasibleMessage: This decision would take your projected cash below your safety threshold.
projects.resultFootnote: We subtract the decision amount from your current cash balance, then compare the projected cash with your safety threshold. The result is feasible above the threshold, borderline near it, and not feasible below it.
